title: w says /w/
parentNote: Today is /w/, and it is made with the lips on their own: push them forward into a tight little circle, the shape you make to blow out a candle, then let the sound slide straight into the vowel. The slip to listen for is yesterday's letter — /v/ presses your top teeth onto your bottom lip, /w/ touches nothing at all — so if "win" comes out "vin", ask to see the teeth lift off. The other habit is a fat "wuh", which turns "wig" into "wuh-ig"; keep it short and let it run into the sound after it. A hand held in front of the mouth settles it — /w/ pushes a puff of air forward, /v/ just buzzes on the lip.

activities.mouthCue: Lips forward in a tiny circle, like blowing out a candle. Nothing touches — no teeth, no tongue.
activities.prompt: This one is made with your lips only. Watch mine, then try.
